_: Every oNN_wall record in the game -- factory index 3 variant 1, the container family's middle variant. Authored exactly like a box: it is built when the layout mask at 0x020EC288 that room record +0x31 selects names its group. psz-godot #581.

the_rule.1_where: set/<NN>/<v>/<room>/<stage><v>_<room>_<set>.rel, the same 24-byte records as boxes and traps
the_rule.2_which_model: record +0x12 == 1 -> object/<NN>/o<NN><v>_prm.rel entry 3.1, the stage's own oNN_wall
the_rule.3_whether_it_is_built: the layout mask for room record +0x31, exactly as for boxes -- [[0,5],[0,1,5],[0,2,5],[3,5],[4,5]]

IT_NEVER_BLOCKS_A_CONNECTION: over all 964 records the smallest distance from a wall to any doorway mouth of its own room is 5.14 cells. The same measurement puts the room warp (factory index 1) at 0.01 and o0c_fence at 1.31, so the ruler does find objects that sit in a doorway.
NOT_ESTABLISHED: no wall BEHAVIOUR is decoded -- hit points, whether it breaks at all, what oNN_wallptcl is spawned by. What is read is that the container constructor FUN_02076650 special-cases record +0x12 == 1 and nothing else: it ADDITIONALLY calls FUN_020304e8, enabling the collider at object+0x14, and stores 2 rather than 3 at object+0x42. (FUN_020304d8, the collider at object+0x10, is called for every variant whose parameter block byte 1 is zero, so it is not the discriminator.)
